FUNCTION Z_ORVANTA_CFG_BC_PREVIEW

    VALUE(IV_VERSION) TYPE STRING

REFRESH et_t006a.
REFRESH et_t006b.

ev_client = sy-mandt.

IF iv_bc_set <> 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' OR iv_version <> 'N'
OR strlen( iv_source_version ) <> 64
OR strlen( iv_target_version ) <> 64

OR iv_target_version CN '0123456789abcdef'.

  RETURN.
ENDIF.
" 整包原生版本固定，额外值、孤立值、通配键均改变此版本。
IF iv_source_version <>

  ev_code = 'SOURCE_NOT_ATTESTED'.

ENDIF.
CALL FUNCTION 'Z_ORVANTA_CFG_BC_READ'
  EXPORTING iv_bc_set = iv_bc_set iv_version = iv_version
  IMPORTING ev_code = lv_code ev_system = lv_system
    ev_client = lv_client ev_user = lv_user
    ev_source_version = lv_source ev_target_version = lv_target
  TABLES et_t006 = lb_t006 et_t006a = lb_t006a
    et_t006b = lb_t006b et_t006c = lb_t006c et_t006d = lb_t006d
  EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.
IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_code <> 'READ_OK'.
  ev_code = 'READ_FAILED'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
IF lv_source <> iv_source_version OR lv_target <> iv_target_version
OR lv_system <> 'GR2' OR lv_client <> '200' OR lv_user <> sy-uname.
  ev_code = 'VERSION_CONFLICT'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
LOOP AT lb_t006b INTO lo_t006b.
  IF lo_t006b-msehi <> 'KNM'.
    ev_code = 'ALIAS_CONFLICT'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
ENDLOOP.
LOOP AT lb_t006c INTO lo_t006c.
  IF lo_t006c-msehi <> 'KNM'.
    ev_code = 'ALIAS_CONFLICT'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
ENDLOOP.
SELECT SINGLE dcpfm INTO lv_dcpfm FROM usr01
  WHERE bname = sy-uname.
IF sy-subrc <> 0.
  ev_code = 'USER_FORMAT_UNAVAILABLE'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
SELECT * FROM scprvals INTO TABLE lt_values UP TO 101 ROWS
  WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
SELECT * FROM scprvall INTO TABLE lt_languages UP TO 101 ROWS
  WHERE id = 'EHS_CUNI_KNM' AND version = 'N'.
DESCRIBE TABLE lt_values LINES lv_count.
IF lv_count <> 41.
  ev_code = 'SOURCE_CHANGED'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
DESCRIBE TABLE lt_languages LINES lv_count.
IF lv_count <> 18.
  ev_code = 'SOURCE_CHANGED'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
" 只预览标准 USE 更新策略；不调用装载、激活、日志或传输函数。
DO 5 TIMES.
  CASE sy-index.
    WHEN 1.
      lv_table = 'T006'.
      lv_rows = 1.
      lv_expected =
        'MANDT|MSEHI|KZEX3|KZEX6|ANDEC|KZKEH|KZWOB|KZ1EH|KZ2' &&
        'EH|DIMID|ZAEHL|NENNR|EXP10|ADDKO|EXPON|DECAN|ISOCOD' &&
        'E|PRIMARY|TEMP_VALUE|TEMP_UNIT|FAMUNIT|PRESS_VAL|PR' &&
        'ESS_UNIT'.
    WHEN 2.
      lv_table = 'T006A'.
      lv_rows = 3.
      lv_expected =
        'MANDT|SPRAS|MSEHI|MSEH3|MSEH6|MSEHT|MSEHL'.
    WHEN 3.
      lv_table = 'T006B'.
      lv_rows = 3.
      lv_expected =
        'MANDT|SPRAS|MSEH3|MSEHI'.
    WHEN 4.
      lv_table = 'T006C'.
      lv_rows = 3.
      lv_expected =
        'MANDT|SPRAS|MSEH6|MSEHI'.
    WHEN 5.
      lv_table = 'T006D'.
      lv_rows = 1.
      lv_expected =
        'MANDT|DIMID|LENG|MASS|TIMEX|ECURR|TEMP|MOLQU|LIGHT|' &&
        'MSSIE|TEMP_DEP|PRESS_DEP'.
  ENDCASE.
  REFRESH lt_fields.
  CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_NAMETAB_GET'
    EXPORTING tabname = lv_table
    TABLES dfies_tab = lt_fields
    EXCEPTIONS not_found = 1 error_message = 2 OTHERS = 3.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lt_fields IS INITIAL.
    ev_code = 'LAYOUT_UNAVAILABLE'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  CLEAR lv_layout.
  LOOP AT lt_fields INTO ls_field.
    IF lv_layout IS INITIAL.
      lv_layout = ls_field-fieldname.
    ELSE.
      CONCATENATE lv_layout ls_field-fieldname
        INTO lv_layout SEPARATED BY '|'.
    ENDIF.
    IF ls_field-inttype NA 'CNIPFsb'
    OR ls_field-datatype = 'CURR' OR ls_field-datatype = 'CUKY'.
      ev_code = 'LAYOUT_UNSUPPORTED'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDLOOP.
  IF lv_layout <> lv_expected.
    ev_code = 'LAYOUT_CHANGED'.
    RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  DO lv_rows TIMES.
    lv_row_index = sy-index.
    lv_index = lv_row_index.
    CLEAR: lv_lang, lv_present.
    CASE lv_row_index.
      WHEN 1. lv_lang = '1'.
      WHEN 2. lv_lang = 'D'.
      WHEN 3. lv_lang = 'E'.
    ENDCASE.
    CASE lv_table.
      WHEN 'T006'.
        CLEAR: ls_t006, lo_t006.
        READ TABLE lb_t006 INTO lo_t006 INDEX 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_present = 'X'.
          ls_t006 = lo_t006.
        ENDIF.
        GET REFERENCE OF ls_t006 INTO lr_row.
        GET REFERENCE OF lo_t006 INTO lr_before.
      WHEN 'T006A'.
        CLEAR: ls_t006a, lo_t006a.
        READ TABLE lb_t006a INTO lo_t006a
          WITH KEY spras = lv_lang.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_present = 'X'.
          ls_t006a = lo_t006a.
        ENDIF.
        GET REFERENCE OF ls_t006a INTO lr_row.
        GET REFERENCE OF lo_t006a INTO lr_before.
      WHEN 'T006B'.
        CLEAR: ls_t006b, lo_t006b.
        READ TABLE lb_t006b INTO lo_t006b
          WITH KEY spras = lv_lang.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_present = 'X'.
          ls_t006b = lo_t006b.
        ENDIF.
        GET REFERENCE OF ls_t006b INTO lr_row.
        GET REFERENCE OF lo_t006b INTO lr_before.
      WHEN 'T006C'.
        CLEAR: ls_t006c, lo_t006c.
        READ TABLE lb_t006c INTO lo_t006c
          WITH KEY spras = lv_lang.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_present = 'X'.
          ls_t006c = lo_t006c.
        ENDIF.
        GET REFERENCE OF ls_t006c INTO lr_row.
        GET REFERENCE OF lo_t006c INTO lr_before.
      WHEN 'T006D'.
        CLEAR: ls_t006d, lo_t006d.
        READ TABLE lb_t006d INTO lo_t006d INDEX 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_present = 'X'.
          ls_t006d = lo_t006d.
        ENDIF.
        GET REFERENCE OF ls_t006d INTO lr_row.
        GET REFERENCE OF lo_t006d INTO lr_before.
    ENDCASE.
    ASSIGN lr_row->* TO <row>.
    ASSIGN lr_before->* TO <before>.
    LOOP AT lt_fields INTO ls_field.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <row>
        TO <value>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        ev_code = 'LAYOUT_CHANGED'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR: lv_value, lv_found, ls_value, ls_language.
      READ TABLE lt_values INTO ls_value WITH KEY
        tablename = lv_table recnumber = 1
        fieldname = ls_field-fieldname.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_found = 'X'.
        lv_value = ls_value-value.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_rows = 3.
        READ TABLE lt_languages INTO ls_language WITH KEY
          tablename = lv_table recnumber = 1
          fieldname = ls_field-fieldname langu = lv_lang.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lv_found = 'X'.
          lv_value = ls_language-value.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_field-fieldname = 'MANDT'.
        lv_value = sy-mandt.
        lv_found = 'X'.
      ELSEIF ls_field-fieldname = 'SPRAS' AND lv_rows = 3.
        lv_value = lv_lang.
        lv_found = 'X'.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_field-keyflag = 'X' AND lv_found IS INITIAL.
        ev_code = 'KEY_MISSING'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_found = 'X'.
        IF ls_field-keyflag IS INITIAL
        AND ( ls_value-flag <> 'USE' AND ls_language-flag <> 'USE' ).
          ev_code = 'SOURCE_FLAG_UNSUPPORTED'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        ev_error_field = ls_field-fieldname.
        TRY.
          CASE ls_field-inttype.
            WHEN 'C'.
              DESCRIBE FIELD <value> LENGTH lv_length
                IN CHARACTER MODE.
              IF strlen( lv_value ) > lv_length.
                ev_code = 'VALUE_TRUNCATED'.
                RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              <value> = lv_value.
            WHEN 'N'.
              IF lv_value CN '0123456789 '.
                ev_code = 'CONVERSION_FAILED'.
                RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              <value> = lv_value.
            WHEN 'I' OR 'P' OR 'F' OR 's' OR 'b'.
              IF ls_field-convexit IS NOT INITIAL.
                ev_code = 'CONVERSION_EXIT_UNREVIEWED'.
                RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              CALL FUNCTION 'SCPR_CT_DECDELIM_CONVERT_ONE'
                EXPORTING decimals = ls_field-decimals
                  datatype = ls_field-datatype
                CHANGING value = lv_value
                EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.
              IF sy-subrc <> 0.
                ev_code = 'CONVERSION_FAILED'.
                RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              CLEAR ls_convert.
              ls_convert-active = 'X'.
              ls_convert-olength = ls_field-outputlen.
              ls_convert-decimals = ls_field-decimals.
              ls_convert-sign = ls_field-sign.
              IF ls_field-inttype = 'F'.
                ls_convert-sign = 'X'.
              ENDIF.
              CALL FUNCTION 'RS_CONV_EX_2_IN_NO_DD'
                EXPORTING input_external = lv_value
                  convert = ls_convert
                IMPORTING output_internal = <value>
                EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.
              IF sy-subrc <> 0.
                ev_code = 'CONVERSION_FAILED'.
                RETURN.
              ENDIF.
          ENDCASE.
        CATCH cx_root.
          ev_code = 'CONVERSION_FAILED'.
          RETURN.
        ENDTRY.
      ENDIF.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field-fieldname OF STRUCTURE <before>
        TO <old>.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        ev_code = 'LAYOUT_CHANGED'.
        RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_present IS INITIAL.
        lv_status = 'NEW'.
      ELSEIF <value> = <old>.
        lv_status = 'EQL'.
      ELSE.
        lv_status = 'CHG'.
      ENDIF.
      CONCATENATE lv_diffs lv_table ':' lv_index ':'
        ls_field-fieldname ':' lv_status ';' INTO lv_diffs.
    ENDLOOP.
    CASE lv_table.
      WHEN 'T006'. APPEND ls_t006 TO lt_t006.
      WHEN 'T006A'. APPEND ls_t006a TO lt_t006a.
      WHEN 'T006B'. APPEND ls_t006b TO lt_t006b.
      WHEN 'T006C'. APPEND ls_t006c TO lt_t006c.
      WHEN 'T006D'. APPEND ls_t006d TO lt_t006d.
  ENDDO.
ENDDO.
" 双版本复读拒绝漂移；用户小数格式也绑定到候选版本。
CALL FUNCTION 'Z_ORVANTA_CFG_BC_READ'
  EXPORTING iv_bc_set = iv_bc_set iv_version = iv_version
  IMPORTING ev_code = lv_code ev_system = lv_system
    ev_client = lv_client ev_user = lv_user
    ev_source_version = lv_source ev_target_version = lv_target
  TABLES et_t006 = lb_t006 et_t006a = lb_t006a
    et_t006b = lb_t006b et_t006c = lb_t006c et_t006d = lb_t006d
  EXCEPTIONS error_message = 1 OTHERS = 2.
IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_code <> 'READ_OK'.
  ev_code = 'READ_FAILED'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
IF lv_source <> iv_source_version OR lv_target <> iv_target_version
OR lv_system <> 'GR2' OR lv_client <> '200' OR lv_user <> sy-uname.
  ev_code = 'VERSION_CONFLICT'.
  RETURN.
ENDIF.
SELECT SINGLE dcpfm INTO lv_dcpfm_after FROM usr01
  WHERE bname = sy-uname.
IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_dcpfm_after <> lv_dcpfm.
